displayDescription: Teal glass and gold tesserae flip face-up into a bulb, then terracotta links and gold nodes set themselves on a midnight-slate panel.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186 WebGLRenderer (InstancedMesh tesserae, MeshPhysicalMaterial stone / teal glass / gold leaf, RoomEnvironment PMREM reflections, PCF soft shadows) — reviewed alternative used because Blender 5.2.2 crashes at Metal GPU detection in this sandbox
motionEngine: scene/mosaic.js pure poseAt(tile, t) functions driven by one paused GSAP timeline proxy (window.__timelines.video)
GSAP opacity tweens for the title only
audioDescription: Silent preview with no audio track.
limitations: Blender, Python bpy and Cycles (the reviewed renderer and motion owner) could not run. Blender 5.2.2 crashes in Metal backend detection before any script executes under this sandbox, including with --factory-startup. scene/mosaic_scene.py is the equivalent authored bpy/Cycles scene, but it was never executed. The delivered frames come from the Three.js InstancedMesh alternative listed in STYLE.json.

Materials are approximations, not path-traced: a clearcoated glass look without real transmission, metallic PBR gold leaf reflecting a procedural RoomEnvironment, and stone with seeded per-tile value, hue and tilt jitter. Shadows are rasterised.
The wall uses a seeded canvas noise texture, not photographed stone.
The title is live HTML text on a backing that matches the rendered stone slab. It is not set in tesserae.

No preview recipe was supplied (tech.preview_recipes is empty). The refresh demonstrates the primary style with a new scene-dependent dark slate and midnight field instead of the earlier beige ground.
Silent: no soundtrack was requested for this preview.
